Insults.trigger: Source KillEventManager remembers the last attacked living entity and emits when it disappears from loadedEntityList; Insults filters players. This is removal detection, not proof of a kill.
Insults.modes: Normal or Hypixel; Hypixel server routing chooses /shout for configured uppercase sidebar game strings, otherwise /ac.
Insults.native_requirements: World-bound attack/removal tracking, typed mode, native chat submission and cleanup; no donor manager/event bus.

Keybind Info.native_requirements: Native fonts/theme/drag/config/GL ownership while retaining rows, key labels, empty state and animation behavior.
